INSERT INTO workspace_invite_link (workspace_id, token, role, expires_at, max_uses, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{token}, #{role},
DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiresInDays} DAY) NULL , #{maxUses}, #{createdById})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, token, role, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, revoked, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace_invite_link WHERE token = #{token}

SELECT l.workspace_id AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, l.role, (l.revoked = 0 AND (l.expires_at IS NULL OR l.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AND (l.max_uses IS NULL OR l.used_count < l.max_uses)) AS valid FROM workspace_invite_link l JOIN workspace w ON w.id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.token = #{token}

SELECT l.id, l.token, l.role, l.expires_at AS expiresAt, l.max_uses AS maxUses, l.used_count AS usedCount, l.revoked, u.display_name AS createdByLabel, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM workspace_invite_link l LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.created_by_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.revoked = 0 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invite_link SET revoked = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revoked = 0
UPDATE workspace_invite_link SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked = 0 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AND (max_uses IS NULL OR used_count < max_uses)
